items.item_text: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

The Department of Surgery is looking to hire a Financial Services Analyst to play a key role in supporting the department's procurement and financial operations. As the primary point of contact for purchasing activities across departments, divisions, research labs, and administrative units, you will oversee procurement transactions, travel and expense reimbursements, and vendor payments while ensuring compliance with University policies and procedures. This position partners closely with faculty, staff, and external vendors to coordinate purchasing activities, resolve financial inquiries, and ensure timely, accurate processing of procurement and payment transactions in support of the department's clinical, research, and academic mission.
Working level of proficiency in the use of standard spreadsheet and word processing software.
Understands procurement policies and systems such as Procurement, Travel systems, etc.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Analytical skills necessary to evaluate the cost effectiveness of purchasing options.
Some knowledge of the organization's departments and operations required in order to meet their procurement needs
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Ability to read and interpret terms and conditions of contracts.
Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, with high degree of accuracy.
